# better-chatbot Conventions — project standards for the better-chatbot AI chat platform

Curated by Skill Harbor — @jackspace's better-chatbot skill, listed here with credit to its creator (standards authored by Jeremy Dawes / Jezweb for the open-source better-chatbot platform at github.com/cgoinglove/better-chatbot): the project-specific conventions, architecture, and contribution guidelines for better-chatbot itself. It teaches the agent the codebase's directory structure (Next.js 15 App Router, AI SDK 5, Better Auth, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL), API architecture with RESTful route conventions, the three-tier tool system (MCP, Workflow, Default), server action validators with the safe() wrapper, database repository patterns, compound component design, DAG workflow builder internals, Playwright E2E test setup, and principles like progressive enhancement, defensive programming, and streaming-first — plus templates for adding tools, API routes, and repositories. Honest caveats: this skill is PROJECT-SPECIFIC — it is only useful inside the better-chatbot repository (for contributions and fixes); if you want portable chatbot patterns for your own projects, see the sibling better-chatbot-patterns listing; last verified 2025-11-04, so check current library versions before contributing. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
